title: Client-Side Discovery
description: Implement client-side discovery where the client queries the registry.

data.text: In client-side discovery, the client queries the service registry directly to find service instances. The client is responsible for load balancing and failover.

terms.definition: The client queries the registry and selects an instance.
Trying another instance when one fails.
A library that talks to the service registry.

items: HashiCorp Consul with DNS or HTTP API

    LB -->|4. Request| S2[Service B]
